name: attack-front
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet of the EXACT accepted zombie decayed human villager shown in the reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT layout to copy. Same gaunt adult human, cloudy dead white eyes, sparse messy dark hair, gray-green decayed skin, ragged dirty beige sleeveless linen tunic, dull brown belt and torn brown trousers and worn brown shoes; unarmed empty five-fingered human hands. Detailed shaded textured retro dungeon illustration, crisp edges and muted materials, same lighting/proportions/clothing tears and anatomy. Human ears, no weapons/armor, never cute. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background and alpha holes, no background, floor, painted shadow, glow, grid, labels or text. Generous transparent outer margins and between poses; no silhouette may touch its neighbor or sheet edge. Same anatomical scale in all frames. FRONT view facing directly toward viewer. Exactly FOUR COMPLETE full-body MELEE SLAM animation frames in a 2x2 SQUARE grid, preferably 1536x1536. Reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Frame 1 WINDUP: zombie leans back slightly raising both empty hands overhead. Frame 2 COIL: shoulders twist and both raised arms pull back ready to strike. Frame 3 IMPACT: zombie lunges torso forward and slams BOTH empty hands downward toward viewer at chest/waist height, head down and mouth open; readable forceful bodily blow. Frame 4 RECOVERY: torso returns to slack hunched stance, arms lower. No weapons, no energy or flash. Consistent anatomical scale and shoe ground row in all four local cells, each humanoid around 500px high plus room above for raised arms. ALL fingers, head, arms and shoes fully visible inside each cell, generous clear margins/gutters especially overhead and between rows. Never touch adjacent poses.
